models.name: LFM2.5-24B-A2B

engines.quant: LFM2.5-24B-A2B served by vLLM; 1,415 output tokens per second at 32 concurrent requests (an L40S gave the best tokens per second per dollar at 1,110); benchmark code public

models.why: A 1,000-token aggregate figure the store did not have: 1,415 output tokens per second at 32 concurrent requests on one A100 SXM4 under vLLM, with the benchmark published rather than quoted — the serving end of the same 24B A2B model that does 184 tok/s single-stream on an M5 Max.
